page.title: Run your marketing with Claude
page.sub: The link from the reel, the one install command, and the first four things to ask it. Checked on 12 Nov 2026.
page.prompt_how: Set it up first (the five steps below), then say this to Claude Code. It asks about your business and saves the answers.
page.prompt_note: Every other skill reads that file first, so you only do this once.
page.tested_text: It's called Marketing Skills, by Corey Haines: **github.com/coreyhaines31/marketingskills**. On 12 Nov 2026 the page showed 59.9k stars, an MIT licence (free to use) and 53 skills, and the install command below is copied from its README. **Not checked:** we haven't installed it on a clean computer or measured results. The numbers in the reel's pictures are examples.
page.tip: **The tip:** do the business set-up first. It's what stops the answers sounding generic.

prompt: Set up my product marketing context. Ask me about my product, my customer and my pitch, one question at a time, then save it.

followups.label: Audit your website
followups.prompt: Run an SEO audit on [your website address]. Tell me the three fixes that matter most, in plain English.
followups.note: This uses the seo-audit skill. You can also type /seo-audit.

followups.label: Rewrite your homepage
followups.prompt: Rewrite my homepage so more visitors buy. Here's the page as it is now: [paste the text]
followups.note: This uses the copywriting skill. It reads your business set-up first, so the words fit your customer.

followups.label: Ask the Marketing Council
followups.prompt: Ask the marketing council: should we raise our prices?
followups.note: The marketing-council skill gives you several expert takes on one decision. Swap in your own question.

checklist.title: Get Claude Code
checklist.detail: It's Anthropic's app that lets Claude work on your computer. It needs a paid Claude plan.

checklist.title: Install Node.js
checklist.detail: It's free, from nodejs.org. The install command needs it.

checklist.title: Run one command
checklist.detail: In your terminal, inside your project folder: npx skills add coreyhaines31/marketingskills

checklist.title: Pick Claude Code when it asks
checklist.detail: If you ask Claude Code to run the command for you, add -a claude-code to the end.

checklist.title: Open Claude Code and paste the prompt
checklist.detail: Start with the business set-up at the top of this page, then try the three below it.
